name: Yasmin Arrieta
life: “I still remember the spare cup left in our empty room.” Sunday often includes a stop at Breakwater Way, where Yasmin stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I recorded the founding meeting on a birthday cassette. I need a working player before the general meeting.
appearance: Yasmin has a wide brow and a narrow jaw. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a rust-colored canvas coat with a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. In conversation Yasmin counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Yasmin thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Yasmin sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To bring the wife back to the coast.
family: Tobias Starr is Yasmin’s cousin. Yasmin puts the kettle on. Tobias chooses the music. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *An empty dedication*, Tobias says, “I printed the first draft on my lunch break.”
connections: Lydia Macrae. They compare using a dividend for a reunion with using one to make a family repayment.

reactions.situation: An unexpected dividend arrives in the wrong envelope
reactions.response: Yasmin checks the payee's name with the teller before opening the envelope.

reactions.situation: A neighbor offers to pay for a favor that was meant kindly
reactions.response: Yasmin accepts a small agreed amount if paying lets the neighbor keep their pride.

reactions.situation: When family demands an immediate answer
reactions.response: Yasmin asks them to walk to the corner together and listen until the corner comes.
